mapper.sql: id, name, type, value, condition_amount, start_time, end_time, total_count, used_count, status, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM coupon WHERE status = 1 AND (total_count = 0 OR used_count < total_count) AND NOW() BETWEEN start_time AND end_time ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE coupon SET used_count = used_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND (total_count = 0 OR used_count < total_count)
